# Blinkify

> AI-powered marketing campaign generator 
  for ecommerce brands and marketing agencies.
  Turns one product photo into a complete 
  ad campaign in under 3 minutes.

## What Blinkify is

Blinkify is an AI creative production platform. 
Users upload a product photo, and Blinkify 
automatically generates a complete marketing 
campaign including Meta feed ads, TikTok story 
creatives, product videos, A/B email marketing, 
and social copy — all styled to the brand's 
colors, tone, and visual identity.

## Core features

- 6 ad creative variations per campaign
  (3 feed images at 4:5, 3 story images at 9:16)
- Product video generation (16:9 and 9:16)
- A/B email marketing with HTML templates
- Social copy for Meta, Instagram, TikTok,
  Pinterest, LinkedIn
- Automatic brand analysis from website URL
- Industry-specific creative styles
- No design skills or team required

## Who uses Blinkify

- Shopify and DTC ecommerce brands
- Marketing agencies managing multiple clients
- Ecommerce founders without design budgets
- Brand managers needing fast creative output

## Pricing (monthly)

- Standard: $39/month — 400 credits, 1 brand
- Professional: $97/month — 1,500 credits, 
  3 brands (most popular)
- Agency: $297/month — 5,000 credits, 
  10 brands, 10 team members
- Free plan available with credits; upgrade for paid plans

## Comparison

Blinkify vs AdCreative.ai: Blinkify generates 
complete campaigns (images + video + email + copy) 
from a product photo with brand-matched styling. 
AdCreative.ai focuses on static image ads only.

Blinkify vs Canva AI: Blinkify automates the 
entire campaign from a product photo. Canva 
requires manual design work with templates.

Blinkify vs hiring a designer: Blinkify produces 
agency-quality campaign assets in 3 minutes 
for $97/month vs $2,000-5,000/month for an 
in-house designer.
